item.title: Our position on open-weights models
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei on open-weights models

item.title: Investigating three real-world incidents in our cybersecurity evaluations
item.description: We found three cases where a Claude model reached the internet from an evaluation environment and accessed real systems. We share what happened and what we're changing.

item.title: Mariano-Florentino (Tino) Cuéllar to join Anthropic as Chief Global Affairs Officer
item.description: Former California Supreme Court Justice Tino Cuéllar joins Anthropic to lead policy, international engagement, and government relations worldwide.

item.title: Improving Fable 5's biology safeguards
item.description: We’re making updates to Claude Fable 5’s biology safeguards in a way that substantially reduces fallbacks.

item.title: How Claude’s text watermark works
item.description: Future Claude models will generate text that contains a watermark to comply with the EU AI Act. We answer questions about how it works and whether it affects outputs.

item.title: Funding better evaluations of AI’s impact on wellbeing
item.description: Anthropic is launching a $5 million grant program to fund independent research into how AI impacts users’ wellbeing.

item.title: Previewing the Model Hardware Standard
item.description: Anthropic is opening a research preview of the Model Hardware Standard (MHS), a shared specification for AI agents to safely operate physical devices, to a first group of scientific research labs and advanced manufacturers.

item.title: Expanding our support for scientists
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.

item.title: Improving our alignment and security efforts
item.description: On July 30, we reported three incidents in which Claude models gained unauthorized access to real computer systems. We are conducting an in-depth analysis of both incidents, and planning to work with METR for an independent review. In the meantime, we’re sharing some of the changes we’ve made over the past month.

item.title: Developing Enterprise Frontier Safeguards with our customers
item.description: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that's working to build reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems.
